title: Prelaminated Particle Boards from Wood and other Lignocellulosic Material - Specification ( First Revision )
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the requirement of prelaminated particle boards for general purpose and for special applications. 1.2 This standard does not cover veneered particle boards.
